decision_rule: A gate passes only when every required machine-readable field and referenced artifact is present. Infrastructure completion and report generation do not substitute for task success or a matched causal comparison.

gates.pass_condition: Four of four signature-disjoint, scripted-feasible held-out placements succeed with one declared learned policy and zero infrastructure failures.
The same learned policy is evaluated on four held-out cases with declared lighting, camera, background, and table-height randomization; all four execute and succeed.
A learned policy for one additional generated task executes and succeeds on at least three held-out seeds with a task verifier.
A machine-readable promotion record binds checkpoint hashes, splits, verifier results, domain randomization, cross-task evidence, parent state, and rollback state.
One normalized task contract executes through gen-env, collect, evaluate, diagnose, and transfer on RoboTwin/SAPIEN and Isaac Sim with backend-native traces and verifiers.
Matched no-memory and memory-enabled runs fix checkpoint, task cases, seeds, and evaluator; the result is reported even if the effect is null or negative.
A material sidecar is extracted from an input observation, imported into a simulator-native material, rendered, and compared against the source with recorded metrics.
A predeclared failure score is compared with actual verifier outcomes over at least twelve executable episodes and reports the correlation with all samples retained.
The SceneAgent robust-policy gates pass or the executed negative result is retained without a promotion claim.
Isaac Sim executes backend-native gen-env, collect, evaluate, and diagnose commands for one normalized task contract; each command emits the declared artifact contract.
gates.current_result: 5 commands, 120 trace steps, 24/24 unique frames, target verifier pass

gates.pass_condition: Transfer maps the same task contract between RoboTwin/SAPIEN and Isaac Sim, records every field mapping or loss, and runs the target verifier.
Every benchmark is explicitly typed as scripted, learned, or replay; scripted success is never counted as learned-policy evidence.
Baseline and candidate use identical checkpoint hash, task cases, seeds, action selection, and verifier; exactly one declared harness surface differs.
Both arms execute, the candidate meets a predeclared improvement threshold without safety regression, and accept or reject is written with parent and rollback references.
The accepted artifact contract is exercised on a second simulator through the same normalized command sequence.
A matched memory/no-memory comparison is executed and reported without requiring a positive effect.
No first-in-field claim is made without a systematic search, public timestamps, and independent audit.
All four TODO reports have repository-tracked HTML bundles with size and SHA-256 manifests.
gates.evidence: scripts/report_delivery.py plus four repository report manifests

gates.pass_condition: All four tracked bundles are mirrored into the declared Downloads paths and independently verified against their manifests.
